title: Security Architect
description:
Cybersecurity Architect (AI and emerging technologies)


Duration: 6 Months


Location: Hybrid (3 days/week in London, Birmingham, or Sheffield)


£300 to £400 a day Inside IR35

A well-established, top-tier firm is looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Architect to lead a crucial AI and digital platform initiative. In this highly visible role, you will act as both a strategic architecture leader and a technical authority-bridging the gap between traditional enterprise risk frameworks and the rapid deployment of GenAI, machine learning models, and hybrid cloud ecosystems.


You will be responsible for the following

  • Drive AI Security Strategy: Champion the definition and deployment of security controls, frameworks, and guardrails for artificial intelligence applications across global operations.
  • Architect Scalable Defense: Lead the architectural design across cloud (AWS/Azure), hybrid, and on-premises environments, aligning controls with frameworks like NIST, ISO 27001, and enterprise risk appetite.
  • Technical Engineering & Automation: Guide cross-functional engineering teams in embedding secure-by-design principles across IAM, network defense, endpoint security, and automated pipelines.
  • Incidents & Threat Intelligence: Oversee deep-dive technical root-cause analyses and provide technical direction during critical vulnerability remediations.
  • C-Suite & Stakeholder Advisory: Translate complex technical risks into clear, business-focused recommendations for non-technical senior executives and technology owners.
  • Team Leadership & Growth: Mentor and elevate a senior team of security architects and engineers, fostering a culture of technical rigor and continuous innovation.


Essential Skills

  • 8 + Years in Cybersecurity architecture in enterprise or regulated environments
  • Good working knowledge of AI/ML security, threat vectors, and risk frameworks.
  • Strong grounding in NIST, ISO 27001, cloud security, and cryptography.
  • Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, or AWS/Azure Security.
  • Proven track record guiding technical teams and influencing senior stakeholders.


6 Months contract - Hybrid working 3 days in office (any office from the location below)


London, Birmingham or Sheffield (either location is fine)


£300 to £400 a day Inside IR35
